text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day when I went shopping at the mall, 
I overheard three members of the Mejiro 
family talking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Sister Ryan, Dober. How do you find the 
taiyaki from this shop?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's so delicious! Thanks for 
bringing me here, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ufufu~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Bright, really. Look at you looking 
so happy."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was really looking forward to the 
three of us going out together♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Big Sister, Ryan-oneesama...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong, Bright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Taiyaki... Would you mind... feeding it to 
me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Bright really is such a spoiled 
sweetheart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Here, say aah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Open wide~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, it is truly delicious, I feel so 
happy~. I would love to have just one more 
bite.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
S-Stop that! That draws attention, so you 
shouldn't do that outside—I mean! We're 
not kids anymore, and to begin with, 
that's just—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait, whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry for bumping into you.
choice_data_list:
Everyone really gets along well, don't 
they?

Everyone really gets along well, don't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I bumped into you! I-I'm so sorry.... Are 
you all right?
choice_data_list:
Everyone really gets along well, don't 
they?

Everyone really gets along well, don't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... I just can't help but spoil my 
cute little sister...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... I just can't help but spoil my 
cute little sister...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dear Sister's comforting embrace feels so 
wonderful~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Headpats from you, Dear Sister, are also 
quite lovely~. ...*glance*.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Bright, really. There, there, good 
girl."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ufufu...♪ I'm so happy~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober stood watching the two of 
them in absolute silence.
choice_data_list:
Why don't you come act a little spoiled 
too, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaat...!? Like I'd ever do that!? No 
way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaat...!? I-I would never do something 
like that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I want to be babied or 
anything...!
choice_data_list:
Maybe having her feed you with an 
"Ahhh---"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to spoil myself with Ryan... I-I'd 
never... Well, maybe just a tiny bit...
choice_data_list:
Maybe having her feed you with an 
"Ahhh---"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Y-You idiot...! There's no way I could 
ever do that!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...! That's just way too 
embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There's no way... I could do that... 
............

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There's no way... I could do that... 
............

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...R-Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hm? Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, say 'aah' for me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah, okay! Aaahn...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chomp)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
F-F-Forget what I just said...! I-It's not 
what you think, seriously...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I was just out of my mind, I swear—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Dober really is so cute.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, it simply makes my heart swoon with 
excitement~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
H-Hwaaat!? N-Now of all times you're 
calling me 'Big Sis'... !?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
E-Eeeek!? No way... At my age... 
Ringside!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"That's... way too embarrassing...! 
............"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"That's... way too embarrassing...! 
............"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: La, lala... lalalala...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...? What's wrong, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ryan... big sister...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...N-N-No way! I-It's just too 
embarrassing after all...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-N-No...! That's not it! That's not it, 
it's nothing like that...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm not trying to be babied, not at 
allーーー!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Dober really is adorable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My heart fluttered for a moment there 
too~♪
